summary: No plan, unknown task, unknown brief, a -C naming no directory and git outside a repository each print one stderr line in the brief's words and exit 1; internal/cli/messages_test.go pins the brief and -C cases and the git case.
verified: vloop task gate T5 exited 0 and printed ok; go test ./internal/... and the B2 e2e test pass, go vet, gofmt, go mod tidy -diff and the linux/windows builds are clean.
notes: Tests changed because the message contract changed (expectation only): 'vloop: no plan: .vloop/state/state.json' -> 'vloop: no plan — vloop run <brief> makes one' in status_test, task_list_test (x2), task_amend_test, task_validate_test, cmd/vloop b2_e2e_test; 'vloop: no task T9' -> 'vloop: no task T9 — vloop task list shows the plan's tasks' in task_list_test, task_amend_test (x4), task_gate_test (x2), and state fixtures_test (RecordGate error text). Mechanism: ErrNoPlan and NoTaskError carry the new text; -C is checked in the root command's PersistentPreRunE (exit 1, nothing created); Globals.gitRoot (internal/cli/config.go) refuses a non-git root with '<root> is not a git repository' and is used by metrics (per-repo), export, brief close and defect --blame. Other git-needing commands (intervention show etc.) were not moved onto it. Only run `go test ./internal/cli` with VLOOP_PLAN_SHA256 unset.
